subject: FILE-CONTROL paragraph
notes: Rule: '<u>FILE-CONTROL</u>. [ file-control-entry ] ...' (cite.py --check 12.4.4.2 "file-control-entry" -> OK §12.4.4.2 General format). Grammar fileControlParagraph = FILE_CONTROL DOT fileControlClauseGroup* : required keyword, required separator period, zero-or-more file-control-entries -- exactly the format; it is optional inside inputOutputSection (FILE-CONTROL? then I-O-CONTROL?), matching §12.4.2. Probes with the pinned cobol.exe at --std 85/2002/2014/2023: (a) FILE-CONTROL. with zero entries compiles and runs (DISPLAY OK1); (b) two SELECT entries compile, write and read back both files (AAAABBBB); (c) FILE-CONTROL without its period is rejected COBOL0307 at every edition. The contents of each file-control-entry belong to §12.4.5 rows, not this one. No spec-derived golden targets the empty-paragraph form or the missing-period rejection, so test-ref is empty (test-needed).
